original_question: For the tree of standard Young tableaux with at most k rows, ordered by containment, determine the automorphism group of the underlying unlabeled tree.
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper very closely: it identifies the right object (the containment tree of standard Young tableaux with at most k rows), the right task (detining its automorphisms), and the right viewpoint (the underlying unlabeled tree rather than a label-preserving tableau automorphism problem).
missing_details: k should be stated as a fixed positive integer, k >= 1.
The tableaux should be specified to be ordinary (unshifted) standard Young tableaux, to distinguish this problem from the shifted case in Problem 2 and the unrestricted case in Problem 3.
The notation k-SYT should be unpacked: its vertices are all standard Young tableaux whose shapes have at most k rows.

The tree structure should be defined explicitly: two tableaux are adjacent when one is obtained from the other by adding a single box containing the new largest entry, equivalently by deleting the largest entry from the larger tableau.
If containment is mentioned, it should be clarified that a tableau T is contained in U when T is the restriction of U to the entries 1, ..., |T|.
It helps to note that this is an infinite rooted tree with root the empty tableau, even though the automorphism question is asked for the underlying unlabeled abstract tree.
The phrase 'unlabeled tree' should be made explicit as meaning the abstract graph obtained by forgetting tableau labels and asking for graph automorphisms.
No ambient ring/field, homogeneity, degree, or nilpotency data are relevant here; the problem is purely combinatorial.
refined_question: For a fixed integer k >= 1, let k-SYT be the infinite tree whose vertices are the ordinary standard Young tableaux T whose shapes have at most k rows, with an edge between T and U whenever U is obtained from T by adding one cell containing the new largest entry |T|+1 (equivalently, T is obtained from U by deleting its largest entry, or T is the restriction of U to the entries 1, ..., |T|). When this containment tree is regarded only as its underlying abstract unlabeled tree, determine its full automorphism group Aut(k-SYT).
justification: The exact target is Problem 8 in Section 2, which asks: 'Consider the tree k-SYT of standard Young tableaux with at most k rows, with the tree structure generated by containment. What are its automorphisms, when it is considered an unlabeled tree?' The draft is therefore already a near-paraphrase of the paper's official formulation. The only sharpening needed is to make the combinatorial objects and adjacency relation explicit so the question is stand-alone. Problem 3 in Section 1 confirms the intended meaning of this family of questions: the author is asking about automorphisms of tableau containment trees viewed as unlabeled trees, not about label-preserving tableau symmetries. Problem 4 in Section 2 supplies the nearby context for why tableaux with a row bound are being singled out at this point in the notebook.
